reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a long-term senior loan comprising of up to USD 64.7 million (EUR 60.5 million) for the Bank's account, and USD 3.4 million (EUR 3.2 million) for the account of Green Climate Fund, to finance the development and construction of a 200 MW onshore wind farm in Ras Ghareb located in the Gulf of Suez region. EBRD financing The Project will sell the produced power to the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC) under a long term power purchase agreement backed by a sovereign guarantee from the Ministry of Finance The Project will further promote private sector participation in the Egyptian power sector and increase the share of renewable energy in the energy mix in line with the nationally declared targets. The Project is expected to improve the environmental characteristics of Egypt's power sector by reducing emissions of local pollutants and CO2, as well as water consumption. The Project will be among the very first to be delivered under the 10 GW renewable program of the Bank-led Energy Pillar of the Nexus Water-Food-Energy Programme (NWFE) initiative, a major policy engagement developed by the Bank on behalf of the Government of Egypt that was announced at COP27 in Sharm El Sheikh.
